diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all rollouts because the model defaulted to scheduling the Driver Certification Block and Radio Procedures Refresher on standard days (Tuesday and Wednesday respectively). This default setting allowed the check to pass even though the scenario did not provide the necessary private facts PF2, which specify the exact requirements for the driver block and truck counts.

C3.why: The inspection status changes the driver block to Friday after 0800, sets the planned block count to six while the currently released count is four, and requires exactly two unreleased trucks to remain on hold.

commitments.detail: Scheduled for Tuesday as per routine

fix_instructions: Tighten check C3 to require the exact planned block vehicle count and currently released vehicle count, as specified in PF2. Specifically, update the check to ensure that the model cannot pass unless the 'planned_block_vehicle_count' and 'currently_released_vehicle_count' match the values provided in PF2 (i.e., six and six respectively).
